## Company Overview 

European omnichannel payment service provider (PSP) operating across the EU, EEA, and UK. Mollie offers online and in-person payment processing, platform-based payment infrastructure, and jurisdiction-specific financial services. Mollie's omnichannel offering connects online and in-person payments under one account.

### Risk Appetite & Prohibited Business Categories

Mollie maintains a clearly defined risk appetite to guide business acceptance and ongoing monitoring. Certain business categories are prohibited due to regulatory, reputational, or operational risks. Key points include:

- Risk appetite aligned with Mollie’s strategic and regulatory framework.
- Mollie maintains a defined list of prohibited and restricted business 
  categories as part of its risk appetite framework. These include sectors 
  that are prohibited outright (e.g. unlicensed gambling, adult content, 
  weapons) and sectors subject to enhanced due diligence. The authoritative 
  list is published in Mollie's User Agreement:
  https://www.mollie.com/legal/user-agreement (add UK vs EU specific pages to link out to)
- Regular reviews and updates ensure compliance with evolving regulations and market conditions.

### Online Payments

Mollie's online payments suite provides businesses with flexible infrastructure to accept payments across channels and customer journeys. It covers everything from a fully hosted checkout experience to direct API integrations, standalone payment links, and automated recurring billing.

How it works

Merchants can accept payments through four main methods. The hosted checkout presents customers with a Mollie-managed payment page, reducing the PCI compliance burden on the merchant. The direct payment API gives developers full control to build native checkout experiences within their own environment. Payment links allow merchants to generate shareable URLs that lead directly to a payment page — useful for invoices, social commerce, or one-off requests. Recurring payments automate collection for subscriptions or instalments using stored mandates.

Product features and USPs

Hosted checkout — a pre-built, Mollie-managed payment page; fast to implement, PCI-friendly, and supports all major payment methods
Direct payment APIs — RESTful API integration giving full control over the payment UX and flow, suited to developers building custom checkout experiences
Payment links — shareable, no-code payment URLs that can be sent via email, SMS, WhatsApp, or embedded in invoices; no customer login or account required
Recurring payments — mandate-based automated billing supporting both fixed and variable amounts, built for subscription businesses and instalment plans
Multi-currency and localisation — accepts payments in multiple currencies with localised payment method display based on customer geography
Broad payment method coverage — supports cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), iDEAL, Bancontact, SEPA Direct Debit, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Klarna, and more

Who it is for

Online payments is suited to any business that sells digitally — e-commerce retailers, SaaS companies, marketplaces, and service providers — regardless of technical resource, thanks to both no-code and full-API implementation paths.

More info: 

Payments overview: https://www.mollie.com/payments

### In-Person Payments (POS or Point of Sale)

Mollie's in-person payments product extends Mollie's payment infrastructure into physical and hybrid retail environments. It allows merchants to accept face-to-face payments using smartphones or dedicated hardware, unified with their online Mollie account and reporting.

How it works

Merchants can accept in-person payments through three routes. Tap to Pay turns a compatible Android or iPhone into a contactless card reader with no additional hardware needed. PAX hardware terminals are purpose-built payment terminals supplied and managed through Mollie. POS software and SoftPOS solutions allow merchants to integrate Mollie's payment acceptance into their existing point-of-sale software stack.

Product features and USPs

Tap to Pay (Android) — turns any NFC-enabled Android device into a card reader using only the Mollie app; accepts contactless cards and digital wallets
Tap to Pay (iPhone) — Apple's native Tap to Pay capability integrated into the Mollie app; no card reader hardware required, fully compliant with Apple's security framework
Tap terminal — a lightweight, portable payment terminal with built-in 
4G and Wi-Fi, all-day battery, and drop- and splash-resistance; ships 
ready to use. Hardware cost: £45 (UK) / €95 (EU). Available on two 
plans — Pay as you go (no monthly fee, one terminal maximum) or Pro 
(monthly fee, includes one terminal licence). See Pricing section for 
full plan details and per-transaction rates.
PAX hardware terminals — certified payment terminals for merchants who prefer dedicated hardware; managed through Mollie with remote configuration capability
POS software integration — Mollie connects with third-party POS software used in retail and hospitality environments
SoftPOS — software-based point-of-sale functionality enabling payment acceptance on commercial off-the-shelf devices without proprietary hardware
Unified reporting — in-person and online transactions appear in the same Mollie Dashboard, giving a single view of revenue across channels
No separate merchant account — in-person payments run through the same Mollie account as online payments, simplifying reconciliation and settlement

Who it is for

In-person payments is suited to omnichannel retailers, hospitality businesses, market traders, pop-up operators, and any merchant who needs to accept face-to-face payments without investing in complex hardware infrastructure.

More info:

### Omnichannel Payments 

Mollie's omnichannel offering unifies a merchant's online and in-person payments under a single Mollie account, so transactions, customers, payouts, and reporting are connected across every channel rather than split across separate systems. 

How it works 

Online and in-store payments run through the same Mollie account and Dashboard. Reconciliation is automated, customers are recognised wherever they pay, and revenue from web checkout and physical terminals appears in one consolidated view. Refunds can cross channels (e.g. an online order returned in-store), and all revenue settles into a single predictable payout. 

Product features and USPs 

Unified dashboard — real-time view of online revenue and physical terminal performance in one place 
Cross-channel refunds — customers can return online orders in-store, reducing manual admin 
Consolidated payouts — all channel revenue in one payout for simpler cash flow and reporting 
Remote terminal management — order, configure, and monitor devices across all locations 
One integration, every method — cards, wallets, local methods, gift cards, vouchers, payment links, and QR across online and physical stores 
Scalable POS suite — Tap to Pay, mobile terminals, and fixed kiosks, from pop-ups to permanent locations 
Broad ecosystem — connects with 350+ POS, commerce, and accounting platforms 
Single customer journey — one connected experience from online checkout to in-store, supporting loyalty and repeat revenue 

Who it is for 

Omnichannel payments suits retailers, hospitality businesses, and brands that sell both online and in physical locations and want a single, connected view of payments, customers, and settlement across channels. 

More info: 

Omnichannel payments overview: https://www.mollie.com/payments/omnichannel-payment-processing

### Acceptance & Risk

Mollie's acceptance and risk product helps merchants maximise legitimate payment conversions while automatically detecting and preventing fraudulent transactions. It operates in the background of the payment flow, applying risk logic without creating friction for genuine customers.

How it works

Mollie applies fraud detection and risk monitoring across every transaction processed through its platform. Machine learning models assess transaction signals in real time, flagging or blocking suspicious activity before it results in a chargeback or financial loss. Merchants can configure risk rules and thresholds where appropriate, and monitor risk exposure directly in the Mollie Dashboard.

Product features and USPs

Fraud detection — real-time transaction scoring using machine learning to identify suspicious patterns before payment is authorised
Fraud prevention — automated blocking and flagging of high-risk transactions, reducing chargebacks and financial exposure without manual review overhead
Risk monitoring — ongoing visibility into risk metrics, flagged transactions, and chargeback rates from within the Mollie Dashboard
Optimised acceptance rates — risk logic is tuned to minimise false positives, avoiding unnecessary declines of legitimate customers
No additional integration required — risk and fraud tooling is embedded within Mollie's core payment processing; no separate vendor or API needed
Chargeback management support — tooling to help merchants respond to and contest chargebacks where appropriate

Who it is for

Acceptance and risk tooling is relevant to any merchant processing online payments through Mollie, but is particularly valuable for e-commerce businesses in higher-risk verticals, merchants with high average order values, and platforms managing payments on behalf of multiple sub-merchants.

More info:

Fraud, acceptance & risk overview: https://www.mollie.com/products/fraud-acceptance-risk

### Invoicing
Mollie's invoicing product allows merchants to create and send invoices directly from within the Mollie platform, with payment collection built in. It removes the need for a separate invoicing tool by combining invoice generation and payment link functionality in a single workflow.

How it works

Merchants create invoices inside the Mollie Dashboard, specifying line items, amounts, and recipient details. Mollie generates the invoice and attaches a payment link, which the customer can use to pay directly online using their preferred payment method. Payment status updates automatically in the Dashboard once the invoice is settled.

Product features and USPs

Invoice creation — build and send professional invoices directly from the Mollie Dashboard without third-party invoicing software
Integrated payment collection — every invoice includes a Mollie-powered payment link, allowing customers to pay immediately via card, bank transfer, or other supported methods
Automatic status tracking — invoice and payment status updates in real time, reducing the need for manual follow-up
Payment method flexibility — customers can pay using any payment method supported by Mollie, not just bank transfer
No additional software needed — invoicing is embedded within the existing Mollie account and Dashboard, keeping workflows consolidated

Who it is for

Mollie's invoicing product is suited to freelancers, service businesses, B2B merchants, and SMEs who need a straightforward way to bill clients and collect payment — without managing separate invoicing software and payment collection tools.

More info:

Invoicing overview: https://www.mollie.com/products/invoicing

### Connect (Platform-based payments infrastructure layer)
Mollie Connect is Mollie's infrastructure layer for platforms, marketplaces, and networks that need to manage payments on behalf of multiple merchants or sub-merchants. It provides the tooling to embed payment acceptance, handle onboarding, route funds, and manage settlement at scale — without building a proprietary payments stack.

How it works

Platforms integrate with Mollie Connect via API to extend Mollie's payment infrastructure to their own merchant base. Mollie handles regulatory compliance, merchant onboarding (including KYC), and payment processing under a single integration. Platforms can control how funds flow between themselves and their sub-merchants through split payments and settlement routing logic.

Product features and USPs

SaaS platform payments — enables SaaS businesses to embed payment acceptance natively into their product, creating a revenue stream and reducing merchant churn
Marketplace payments — supports multi-party payment flows where funds are split between a marketplace operator and sellers, with Mollie handling compliance and disbursement
Franchise network payments — allows franchise operators to centralise payment infrastructure across franchise locations while maintaining individual merchant settlement
E-commerce platform integrations — pre-built integrations with major e-commerce platforms (WooCommerce, Magento, Shopify, etc.) for rapid merchant onboarding
Merchant onboarding and sub-merchant management — Mollie handles KYC and regulatory onboarding for sub-merchants, removing compliance burden from the platform
Split payments and settlement routing — configurable rules for how funds are divided and distributed between platform, marketplace operator, and individual merchants
Revenue share models — platforms can configure service fees or revenue share arrangements within the payment flow
Single API integration — one Mollie Connect integration supports all sub-merchants on the platform, rather than each merchant integrating independently

Who it is for

Connect is designed for SaaS companies, marketplace operators, franchise networks, and e-commerce platform providers who want to embed payments as a core part of their product offering and manage multiple merchants under a single payments infrastructure.

### Mollie Capital 

Mollie Capital provides a lump-sum cash advance to eligible merchants. Repayment happens automatically as a fixed percentage deducted from the merchant's daily Mollie payment volume. There are no fixed monthly instalments — repayment naturally speeds up in busy periods and slows during quiet ones, matching the merchant's cash flow.

The advance comes with a single flat fee, calculated at the time of the offer. There is no compound interest, no early repayment penalty, and no hidden fees. The total repayment amount is known upfront.

Eligibility

Mollie Capital is available exclusively to merchants who already use Mollie as their payment provider. Eligibility is determined automatically using the merchant's Mollie payment history — no lengthy credit application, no traditional collateral. Eligible merchants see an offer directly in their Mollie Dashboard.

Product features and USPs

Fast access to capital — offers are generated automatically; funding typically arrives within 1–2 business days of signing
Revenue-based repayment — repayment scales with daily revenue, not a fixed calendar
Transparent, single fee — one factor rate applied upfront; total cost is visible before acceptance
No dilution or collateral — no equity stake, no property security required
Embedded in the Mollie Dashboard — merchants apply, sign, and track repayment without leaving Mollie
Renewable — once repaid, eligible merchants may receive a follow-on (top-up) offer
Powered by payment data — credit decisioning uses actual Mollie transaction history, not just credit bureau scores

Who it is for

Mollie Capital is suited for e-commerce businesses, retail merchants, and service providers who process card and online payments through Mollie and need working capital for inventory, marketing, hiring, or expansion — without the complexity or wait of a bank loan.

More info:

Capital overview: https://www.mollie.com/products/capital

### Business Accounts 

Mollie's Business Accounts product gives eligible merchants a dedicated business payment account held within the Mollie platform. It extends Mollie beyond payment processing into day-to-day business banking functionality, allowing merchants to hold, manage, and spend funds — all from within the same platform they use to accept payments.

How it works

Merchants based in the Netherlands can open a Mollie Business Account from within the Mollie Dashboard for €9/month, with the first 12 months free. Once active, payment revenue settles directly into the Business Account, with payouts available every day of the year including weekends and public holidays. Merchants can create multiple accounts each with their own Dutch IBAN, issue Mollie Cards to themselves and their team, pay suppliers via bank transfer or Direct Debit, and connect to accounting software — all without leaving Mollie.

Product features and USPs

Multiple accounts with dedicated IBANs — create up to 5 Dutch IBANs to separate funds by purpose (e.g. VAT, payroll, store accounts) and automate money movement between them
365-day payouts — payment revenue pays out every day of the year, including weekends and public holidays; Mollie Tap and Tap to Pay funds arrive within 24 hours
Mollie Cards — up to 5 free virtual debit cards for the merchant and their team, with individual spend limits, usable online, in-store, and via Apple Pay and Google Pay; 2% cashback on all card spend until 30 June 2026 (limited offer)
Free incoming transactions — no fees on incoming payments or transfers
100 free outgoing transactions per month included in the base plan
Pay from one place — settle one-off bills via bank transfer, set up recurring costs via Direct Debit, and shop online with iDEAL or Wero, all directly from the Business Account
Automated bookkeeping — integrates with 17 accounting tools including Exact, Twinfield, SnelStart, and Moneybird; transactions sync automatically in real time
Consolidated financial view — payment processing activity and business account balances visible in the same Mollie Dashboard
Human customer support — 24/7 support from real people
Send money globally — coming soon
Multi-currency accounts — coming soon

Pricing

€9/month. Free for the first 12 months. No fixed contract — cancel any time.

Geographic availability

Currently available to merchants registered in the Netherlands, including sole traders through to BVs. Belgium availability is planned. Other markets have not been announced.

Who it is for

Mollie Business Accounts is suited to Dutch SMEs who already use Mollie for payment processing and want to consolidate payment acceptance, fund management, business spending, and bookkeeping into a single platform — replacing or reducing reliance on a traditional business bank account.

More info: 

Business accounts overview: https://www.mollie.com/products/business-accounts

### Dashboard & Reporting

Mollie's Dashboard is the central hub through which merchants manage their entire Mollie account — from monitoring payments and settlements to accessing reports, managing operations, and collaborating with their team. It is designed to consolidate financial management into a single interface, reducing the need to move between multiple tools.

How it works

Merchants access the Mollie Dashboard via web browser or the Mollie mobile app for iOS and Android. From a single interface they can monitor live payment activity, view balances, manage orders, issue refunds, generate payment links, access capital, export reports, and connect accounting software — across all their Mollie products and payment channels.

Product features and USPs

Real-time transaction monitoring — live view of incoming payments, pending settlements, and available balances across all payment methods and channels
In-depth reporting and statistics — access revenue data, conversion metrics, and payment performance broken down by period, currency, and payment method
Flexible data export — export settlements, invoices, and transaction reports in CSV, MT940, and CODA formats for reconciliation and accounting purposes
Payment link and QR code generation — create and share payment requests instantly from within the Dashboard, from any device
Order and operations management — ship orders, issue refunds, and process payments directly from the Dashboard without needing a separate system
POS terminal management — order and manage point-of-sale terminals and Tap to Pay devices from within the Dashboard
Fraud and acceptance rate tools — real-time chargeback monitoring, 3DS management, and acceptance rate optimisation tools to protect revenue
Business notifications — real-time alerts and updates on payment activity, accessible 24/7
Team collaboration with roles and permissions — invite team members and assign designated access levels to control what each user can see and do
Accounting integrations — connect to bookkeeping and accounting software to automatically sync transaction data
Mobile app — full Dashboard access on iOS and Android, enabling merchants to manage their business from anywhere
Onboarding task management — guided setup tasks help new merchants activate payments, order terminals, and configure their account efficiently

Who it is for

The Mollie Dashboard is used by all Mollie merchants — from solo traders checking daily revenue to finance teams at larger e-commerce businesses managing reconciliation, reporting, and multi-user access. It is the operational centre of the Mollie platform, relevant to any business using Mollie products.

More info:

Mollie dashboard overview: https://www.mollie.com/products/dashboard

### Pricing

Pricing tiers

Standard pricing — pay per transaction only, with no monthly fees, no contracts, and no setup costs; all features included
Volume pricing — available for merchants processing more than €100,000 per month; includes a dedicated account manager, IC++ pricing, volume and multi-product discounts, and country-specific rates

### Cross-Border Currency & FX Handling

Mollie supports cross-border transactions and payments with multi-currency capabilities, allowing merchants to accept and settle payments in various currencies. 

Key features include:

- Support for major global currencies and local currencies in supported markets.
- Multi-currency invoicing and reporting to simplify accounting and reconciliation.

Mollie supports multi-currency payment acceptance. FX handling and settlement currency options are configured at the account level. For current rates, supported currencies, and fee structure, contact Mollie directly. A dedicated public page for this topic is not currently available.

*Note: A dedicated public page for this topic is currently under development.*

### Developer Resources

For detailed API documentation and developer guides, please visit the 
Mollie Developer Portal at https://docs.mollie.com.

**Available APIs**

Balances, Captures, Customers, Invoices, Mandates, Methods, Payments, 
Payment Links, Settlements, Subscriptions, Terminals, Webhooks, 
Webhook Events.

**Authentication**

Requires an Advanced access token (organisation token). API keys are 
not supported. The scope profile.read is required as a minimum; 
additional scopes should be added for each API used.

**Compatibility**

Compatible with any client supported by the official Model Context 
Protocol specification, including AI agents and IDEs. Mollie hosts 
the MCP server; the client is hosted by the developer.

**Geographic availability**

Available across all supported Mollie markets, including the 
United Kingdom.

**Data and privacy**

The MCP server does not store or log personal data. Payment API 
responses may include personal data such as customer names, email 
addresses, phone numbers, and billing addresses, which are passed 
to the developer's chosen AI client. Developers are responsible for 
ensuring their AI provider's data handling is compatible with 
applicable data protection obligations.

Privacy policy: https://www.mollie.com/legal/privacy

**Developer documentation and configuration examples**

https://docs.mollie.com/docs/getting-started

## About This Site

This website supports multiple regions and languages using a subfolder URL structure to provide localized content tailored to specific markets. The root path (/) serves as the global default market in English. Regional and country-language prefixes indicate market-specific localization and language variants.

The site’s primary goal is to provide clear, localized information about Mollie’s payment services specifically designed to meet the needs of merchants, ecommerce businesses, marketplaces, and platform operators across Europe, the UK, and beyond. It aims to support these merchants in understanding, adopting, and optimizing Mollie’s payment solutions to grow their businesses effectively in their local markets.

The site supports the following regional and language-specific subfolders:

- /gb/ - English (United Kingdom market)
- /nl/ - Dutch (Netherlands market)
- /be/ - Dutch (Belgium market; Flemish-speaking audience)
- /be-fr/ - French (Belgium market; French-speaking audience)
- /fr/ - French (France market)
- /de/ - German (Germany market)
- /at/ - German (Austria market)
- /it/ - Italian (Italy market)
- /se/ - Swedish (Sweden market)
- /pl/ - Polish (Poland market)
- /pt/ - Portuguese (Portugal market)
- /no/ - Norwegian (Norway market)
- /es/ - Spanish (Spain market)
- /fi/ - Finnish (Finland market)
- /hu/ - Hungarian (Hungary market)
- /si/ - Slovenian (Slovenia market)
- /cz/ - Czech (Czech Republic market)
- /dk/ - Danish (Denmark market)

- /lv/ - Latvian (Latvia market)

- /et/ - Estonian (Estonia market)
- /bg/ - Bulgarian (Bulgaria market)
- /el/ - Greek (Greece market)
- /hr/ - Croatian (Croatia market)
- /lt/ - Lithuanian (Lithuania market)

Routing Model:

- The root path (/) represents the global default market in English.
- Regional prefixes (e.g., /gb/, /nl/, /be/, /fr/, /de/, /at/, /it/, /se/, /pl/, /pt/, /no/, /es/, /fi/, /hu/, /si/, /cz/, /dk/, /is/, /lv/, /ro/, /sk/, /et/, /bg/, /el/, /hr/, /lt/) indicate market-specific localization.
- Country-language prefixes (e.g., /be-fr/) indicate language variants within a single country.
- Language is determined by the content served at each URL, while the market scope is determined by the URL prefix.

Belgium is served by two subfolders: /be/ (Dutch-language, Flemish 
audience) and /be-fr/ (French-language, Walloon and Brussels audience). 
Neither subfolder represents all of Belgium independently.

## Main Content Areas

- **Core Functions**: Detailed breakdown of Mollie's product offerings and key functionalities, covering online payments, in-person payments, omnichannel payments, invoicing, platform infrastructure, capital, and business accounts. Includes market-specific availability and links to relevant product pages.

- **Pricing**: Overview of Mollie's transparent, pay-as-you-go pricing model. Covers transaction fees by payment method, absence of monthly fees for standard accounts, volume discount eligibility, and additional costs for value-added services. (For detailed pricing information, visit https://www.mollie.com/pricing)

- **Integrations**: A directory of Mollie's available payment plugins and integrations, providing structured information on platform compatibility, supported payment methods, available features, supported countries, and integration support options to help merchants identify and implement the right solution for their stack. (e.g. WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento, Lightspeed, Wix)

- **Payment Methods**: A categorised overview of all payment methods supported by Mollie, including cards, local alternative payment methods, wallets, and bank transfers. Describes each method to help merchants understand coverage, regional availability, and customer suitability. (e.g. iDEAL/Wero, Klarna, Apple Pay, Bancontact, SEPA direct debit)

- **Growth**: A collection of practical guides, how-to articles, and expert content designed to help merchants and partners scale their business. Covers topics beyond Mollie's direct product offerings, including conversion optimisation, market expansion, and ecommerce best practices. (i.e. PSD3 guide, What is unified commerce?, Understanding payment rates, Guide to payment processing fees). 

- **Success Stories**: Real-world case studies and partner testimonials illustrating how Mollie's products and integrations have delivered measurable outcomes for businesses across Europe, building trust and demonstrating product impact across industries and merchant sizes.

- **News**: Mollie-specific announcements covering company updates, product launches, press releases, partnerships, and events, providing a reliable source for the latest developments from Mollie.

## Key Pages
- [Integrations Overview](https://www.mollie.com/integrations) - A directory and listing of Mollie’s payment plugins and integrations, providing detailed, structured information on features, compatibility, supported countries, payment methods, and support to help merchants choose the right integration.
- [Payment Methods Overview](https://www.mollie.com/payments/payment-methods) - An overview of all payment methods supported by Mollie, describing each option to help merchants understand and offer the best payment choices to their customers.
- [Growth Resources](https://www.mollie.com/growth) - A collection of guides, how-to articles, and expert content designed to support merchants and partners in growing their business with educational and practical resources beyond Mollie’s direct product offerings.

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {

    // Function to extract hostname from a URL
    function getHostname(url) {
      var a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      return a.hostname;
    }

    // Get current page's hostname
    var currentHostname = window.location.hostname;

    // Get referrer's hostname, if referrer exists
    var referrerHostname = document.referrer ? getHostname(document.referrer) : '';

    // Check if we've already set the session storage for this session and if the referrer is different from the current hostname
    if (!sessionStorage.getItem('initialLandingSet') && currentHostname !== referrerHostname) {
      // Capture the full URL including query parameters
      var landingUrl = window.location.href;
      // Store the URL in session storage
      sessionStorage.setItem('__sf_campaign_url', landingUrl);
      localStorage.setItem('__sf_campaign_url', landingUrl);
      document.cookie = "__sf_c_campaign_url_=" + landingUrl + "; path=/; domain=.mollie.com; secure; samesite=strict";
      document.cookie = "__sf_c_referral_=" + referrerHostname + "; path=/; domain=.mollie.com; secure; samesite=strict";

      // Function to get a specific cookie value
      function getCookieValue(name) {
        const cookies = document.cookie.split("; ");
        for (let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
          const parts = cookies[i].split("=");
          if (parts[0].trim() === name) {
            return decodeURIComponent(parts[1]);
          }
        }
        return undefined;
      }

      // Retrieve the _ga cookie value
      var gaCookieValue = getCookieValue('_ga');
      // If the _ga cookie exists, store its value in session storage under the key 'sf_ga_id'
      if (gaCookieValue) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('sf_ga_id', gaCookieValue);
        localStorage.setItem('sf_ga_id', JSON.stringify(gaCookieValue));
      } else {
        sessionStorage.setItem('sf_ga_id', localStorage.getItem('gtmBrowserId'))
        localStorage.setItem('sf_ga_id', localStorage.getItem('gtmBrowserId'));
      }

      // Store the document.referrer in session storage under the key 'gtm_referrer', if it exists and is different from the current hostname
      if (document.referrer && currentHostname !== referrerHostname) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('__sf_referrer', document.referrer)
        localStorage.setItem('__sf_referrer', document.referrer)
      }

      // Set a flag indicating that the session storage has been set for this session
      sessionStorage.setItem('initialLandingSet', 'true');
      localStorage.setItem('initialLandingSet', 'true');
    }
  });

    function getHostname(url) {

    // Get current page's hostname
    var currentHostname = window.location.hostname;

    var referrerHostname = document.referrer ? getHostname(document.referrer) : '';

    if (!sessionStorage.getItem('initialLandingSet') && currentHostname !== referrerHostname) {
      // Capture the full URL including query parameters

      sessionStorage.setItem('__sf_campaign_url', landingUrl);

      document.cookie = "__sf_c_campaign_url_=" + landingUrl + "; path=/; domain=.mollie.com; secure; samesite=strict";

      function getCookieValue(name) {
        const cookies = document.cookie.split("; ");
        for (let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
